title: Make the Subway a working board: pick beads in select mode, drag or menu-move
deviations_from_card: (1) usePipelineBulk gained updateSelection(update: cur => Set) instead of setSelectedMany(ids, on): the board hands it subwayInteraction.toggleCellSelection, so the pure function IS the production path (same side effects: clears bulkResult, dispatches selectionChanged). (2) Added commitDrop(entry,target,axis,mode,onMove) to the pure module so case 5's 'moveEntry exactly once' is testable with a spy; drag drop and every menu item both call it. (3) Grew outside write_set by one test and one shared surface: app/features/hiring/pipeline/pipelineBoardRoles.test.ts (source guard pinned the old empty-station title/button expression; now pins the new one and still forbids a button on an empty cell) and perf-budget.json (app/page.tsx 1387/8694 -> 1389/8716, this card's share only). (4) Catalogs: 2 new keys pipeline.board.cellSelect / dropRefused; reused candidateRow.selectCandidate / moveTo / menuHint / openProfile / menuFor.
notes: tsc: only errors are in the untracked foreign kpi-sim/ tree (not mine, pre-existing). i18n:check was red mid-build on a sibling's uncommitted app/_lib/readiness.ts codes; green on my keys (and green at my catalog commit). test:perf is red on page.tsx 1390/1389 modules and 8722/8716 KB: the +1 module / ~7 KB is a sibling's UNCOMMITTED billing/spend readinessFindings.ts + SpendEngineFacts/useSpendData growth, plus the known job-ingest.ts 402/400 line; my share (+3 modules, ~28.9 KB: subwayInteraction.ts + the previously orphaned PipelineCandidateMenu.tsx + pipelineMenuPosition.ts + wiring) is budgeted. Full test:unit green. Not verified in a browser (no dev server per the brief): the both-theme visual check of the coral selected ring / check badge and the moss drop tint is still owed, and HTML5 drag + Shift+F10 are browser behaviour with no e2e journey. Touch still cannot move a bead from the board (no visible menu trigger) - recorded as a Known gap in docs/features/pipeline/README.md. Keyboard move does not announce ('board.movedAnnounce' exists but no live region was added) and focus is not restored to the moved bead.
